citeAs: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu (2025). Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv:2510.20888.
creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu (ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
description: VAP-Data is the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation, containing over 100K curated paired videos across 100 semantic conditions spanning 4 primary categories: concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement. The dataset was bootstrapped by curating ~2K high-quality real reference images and using commercial visual-effects model APIs and community LoRAs to generate paired videos.
name: VAP-Data
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may cause VAP to inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was bootstrapped by curating ~2K high-quality real images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. These images were then matched with Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Approximately 2K high-quality real images collected from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. These images were used as reference images to generate paired videos via commercial model APIs and community LoRAs.
rai:dataLimitations: VAP-Data was created using visual effects templates from commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs, making it synthetic and derived from other generative models. The semantic conditions are relatively limited and may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. Building a large, real-world, semantic-controlled video dataset is left for future work.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Each reference image was matched to all compatible visual-effects templates (some templates restrict subject categories). The dataset covers 100 semantic conditions across 4 primary categories: concept, style, motion, and camera. For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from 4 categories with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and associated model are intended for research, education, and creative prototyping only. Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigations include a research-only release and default content filters blocking clearly harmful categories.
rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating unified semantic-controlled video generation models. The dataset supports concept-guided, style-guided, motion-guided, and camera-guided video generation. It is intended for research, education, and creative prototyping.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial model APIs (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs were used to generate paired videos. Gemini-2.5-Pro and GPT-5 were used for automatic semantic alignment scoring in evaluation.
